title: Sulfur dioxide in three dimensions
hook: Turn a model of SO₂ and examine its shape.

knows: Atoms or cells can be represented with simplified models.
doesNotKnow: Two bonding regions and a lone pair surround sulfur. The positions of the three atoms make a bent molecular structure.

misconception: A familiar diagram automatically reveals the structure or function.
objective: Two bonding regions and a lone pair surround sulfur. The positions of the three atoms make a bent molecular structure.

claims.text: Question, stage and reveal: Two bonding regions and a lone pair surround sulfur. The positions of the three atoms make a bent molecular structure.
The stage is a schematic model and is not drawn to scale.

recall.question: What is the molecular shape of SO₂ around its central atom?
recall.why: Two bonding regions and a lone pair surround sulfur. The positions of the three atoms make a bent molecular structure.
